import math

def gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

a, b, max_limit = map(int, input().split())
target_ratio = a / b
closest_diff = float('inf')
best_num = 0
best_den = 1

for i in range(1, max_limit + 1):
    numerator = (a * i) // b
    ratios = [
        numerator / i,
        abs(numerator - 1) / i,
        (numerator + 1) / i
    ]
    candidates = [numerator, abs(numerator - 1), numerator + 1]

    for j in range(3):
        diff = abs(target_ratio - ratios[j])
        if diff < closest_diff:
            closest_diff = diff
            best_num = candidates[j]
            best_den = i

if abs(1.0 - target_ratio) <= (abs(best_num / best_den) - target_ratio) + 1e-9:
    best_num = 1
    best_den = 1

g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
print(f"{best_num // g}/{best_den // g}")
